## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AdriDob/rastrohunteralpha.git
cd rastrohunteralpha
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python run.py
```

## Features

- **Autonomous AI Agents** — Work bug bounty, development, and revenue generation 24/7
- **Mission Control** — Central dashboard for managing autonomous operations
- **Work Cycles** — Security, Forge, Pulse, Vault, Atlas for specialized workflows
- **Multi-Platform** — Desktop, Android, Wear OS support
- **Premium Design** — Minimalist dark command center interface
